purpose: Partition the current 46 paper-manifest paths into provisional release candidates and paths that require aggregate projection, replacement or exclusion before a curated public release.

scope.inspection: JSON key paths, value types, string lengths, Git tracking, generic credential literals and known upstream-rights boundaries; no body values reproduced in this artifact.

replace_or_exclude_before_release.reason: Contains 140 nonempty records[].public_envelope.public_text values from an upstream source without verified redistribution terms.
replace_or_exclude_before_release.safe_projection: Record identity, source revision, public-text hash, expected family, deterministic mixed order and routing metadata; reconstruct public text from the pinned upstream revision.

replace_or_exclude_before_release.reason: Contains per-record corrected and released repair identities in addition to aggregate endpoint results.
replace_or_exclude_before_release.safe_projection: Publish full-denominator aggregate counts, group membership hashes, endpoint sensitivity, correction/regression categories and terminal artifact hashes without repair identity.

replace_or_exclude_before_release.reason: Contains per-record static/evolved repair objects and repair hashes.
replace_or_exclude_before_release.safe_projection: Publish record membership hashes, status counts, candidate counts, route identity and output hashes; reconstruct method outputs only inside the licensed benchmark environment.

replace_or_exclude_before_release.reason: Contains per-record routed output objects, including repair objects for the OR-Debug family.
replace_or_exclude_before_release.safe_projection: Publish route, status, direct-output hash, mixed-output hash and exact-equivalence result without the repair object.

exclude_from_public_tree_outside_manifes.reason: Tracked private path containing upstream public text.
Tracked private derived-output path pending content and upstream-rights review.

structural_scan.claim_boundary: Key/length/literal inspection is a conservative structural screen, not final semantic redaction, licensing advice or author approval.

admission_gates_for_each_provisional_can: No credential, request body, response body or evaluator-only answer value.
No upstream task text or third-party source code without verified redistribution terms.
Only the minimum identity, hash, aggregate, proof or reconstruction metadata required for the paper claim.
File hash is rebound in the final release manifest after any projection or redaction.
Author-selected first-party license and all upstream attribution are present.
The candidate participates in a successful credential-free clean-clone reconstruction.

decision.permitted_claim: A narrow provisional allowlist partition exists; four manifest paths require safe projections and two tracked private paths require exclusion before release.
prohibited_claims: All 42 provisional candidates have completed legal or semantic review.
The current paper manifest can be published unchanged.
The public repository is clean-clone reproducible.
Absence of generic secret literals proves absence of sensitive content.
